texts: Hibernating myocardium is living muscle that decreases its force of contraction in response to an inadequate supply of blood and energy: B is the answer.
It is still viable, and its function recovers after revascularization.
Muscle that keeps contracting poorly after the supply has returned is stunned myocardium, and muscle with no metabolic activity at all is dead.
Memory hook: the bear sleeps and turns the fan slowly while the coal is short, and wakes when the cabbage brings the coal back.
